sections.content: In the Mechanical Industry, the Design Engineering Department (Research & Development) is crucial for the success of products in the market. Our Post-Graduate Program in Mechanical Engineering Design is designed to equip students with advanced knowledge and skills, making them highly suitable for industry roles in the domain of Design & Analysis (Research & Development). As Technology evolves rapidly, there is an increasing demand for professionals who can keep pace with these changes. Modern Industries are seeking versatile candidates who can handle multiple domains, not just expertise in a single area. Our Program addresses this need by preparing technocrats who are ready to meet both local and Global Industry demands. The teaching and learning processes are meticulously designed and rigorously followed, ensuring academic excellence, as evidenced by our strong university results. Our laboratory facilities are state-of-the-art, featuring the latest tools, equipment, and experimental setups to help students gain proficiency in handling cutting-edge technologies. Additionally, through skill development programs and workshops, our postgraduate students are transformed into the well-rounded professionals needed by both industry and research organizations. APCOER is working under the Mentorship of COEP Technological University, Pune as well as having the Remote Center of Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Bombay.

### ME Coordinator (Mechanical Engineering Design)
In the Mechanical Industry, the Design Engineering Department (Research & Development) is crucial for the success of products in the market. Our Post-Graduate Program in Mechanical Engineering Design is designed to equip students with advanced knowledge and skills, making them highly suitable for industry roles in the domain of Design & Analysis (Research & Development). As Technology evolves rapidly, there is an increasing demand for professionals who can keep pace with these changes. Modern Industries are seeking versatile candidates who can handle multiple domains, not just expertise in a single area. Our Program addresses this need by preparing technocrats who are ready to meet both local and Global Industry demands. The teaching and learning processes are meticulously designed and rigorously followed, ensuring academic excellence, as evidenced by our strong university results. Our laboratory facilities are state-of-the-art, featuring the latest tools, equipment, and experimental setups to help students gain proficiency in handling cutting-edge technologies. Additionally, through skill development programs and workshops, our postgraduate students are transformed into the well-rounded professionals needed by both industry and research organizations. APCOER is working under the Mentorship of COEP Technological University, Pune as well as having the Remote Center of Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Bombay.
